summary: Rand's view of what standards computer service centers on the network should follow, written as input for a panel discussion at the October 1971 meeting. It argues that common appearance and behavior across service centers would help users, and that service centers must follow the official network protocols.

eli5.summary: If every shop of a kind looked and worked the same, customers would find them easy. This note argues that computer service centers should follow common rules so users can move between them.
